name: battlehub-combat-masks
doc: Which choices of an action head a fighter may make, from its observation alone (the values as the model takes them: scaled and clipped). A choice listed here is allowed when any of its alternatives holds, an alternative being a list of conditions that must all hold; a choice not listed is always allowed. The training (ml/pvp_sim2/masks.py, MaskablePPO), the evaluation and the mod (core/ml/CombatMasks, bot/LearnedFight) set the logits of a choice that is not allowed to minus infinity before choosing. So choosing something the fighter does not carry is no longer a choice that does nothing. Every head keeps at least one choice that is always allowed (the weapon, not using).
